changed: Codex review round 1 on H4, ten findings fixed with regression tests: bash-guard hook for docker on denied containers (any executable path, wrappers, compound forms) and git push/merge/rebase/reset --hard behind global options (ask); renames report both ends; an unknown base never counts as new; the unattended Stop rechecks every stop; a local closed marker keeps a closed task closed for the scope hook until refresh-task or new-task; tidy formats only changed UI files in the Prettier scope and reports formatter failures; the settings test models compound commands; eng-session research wording. Live in a scratch clone (claude -p, dontAsk): /fakebin/docker stop odoo-bench-db-1 was denied by bash-guard and the fake docker did not run; git -C . push origin HEAD was refused with the ask reason.

rulings.ruling: bash-guard runs in the stdlib hook script, not the harness CLI, so each Bash call costs no uv start-up
rulings.cost_if_wrong: the guard logic is tested through the script, not as a package function

rulings.ruling: The closed marker is local and git-ignored: scope relaxation is a per-checkout concern, and committing it would dirty the tree after close-check
rulings.cost_if_wrong: a fresh clone recomputes closure from close-check, which needs a clean tree

rulings.ruling: The unattended Stop gate no longer exempts a continued stop; Claude Code caps consecutive Stop blocks itself
rulings.cost_if_wrong: an unattended run that cannot close keeps trying until that cap
